requirements.original_text: Tenderers to supply ALL required items based on scope of works mentioned in Section 1.1 in RFP Document.
requirements.rejection_quote: Failure to comply with any of the above criteria will result in unsuccessful bid for the tender

requirements.original_text: Each part (Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3) of the tender proposal is to be submitted together in three (3) separate envelopes.
requirements.rejection_quote: The Bank does not accept responsibility for the premature opening (and therefore rejection) or mishandling of envelopes not properly sealed or not correctly labelled.
requirements.explanation: The proposal must be split into three separate envelopes: Envelope A (Mandatory), Envelope B (Technical), and Envelope C (Commercial).
requirements.source_excerpt: 2.3 Submission of Proposal ... c) Each part (Part 1, Part 2 and Part 3) of the tender proposal is to be submitted together in three (3) separate envelopes.

requirements.original_text: The closing date and time of this tender is on Friday, 4 June 2021 latest by 3:00 p.m. Tender proposals received after the closing date and time shall be invalid and will not be considered.
requirements.rejection_quote: shall be invalid and will not be considered
requirements.explanation: The tender must be submitted by 3:00 PM on June 4, 2021. Late submissions will be disqualified.
requirements.source_excerpt: 2.3 Submission of Proposal ... h) Closing date and validity period of tender proposal: ... The closing date and time of this tender is on Friday, 4 June 2021 latest by 3:00 p.m.

requirements.original_text: Tender proposals submitted by facsimile, e-mail, telex, telegram or any other means will NOT be considered or accepted.
requirements.rejection_quote: will NOT be considered or accepted
requirements.explanation: Only physical submissions into the designated tender box are allowed; electronic or faxed submissions will be rejected.
requirements.source_excerpt: 2.3 Submission of Proposal ... e) Tender proposals submitted by facsimile, e-mail, telex, telegram or any other means will NOT be considered or accepted.

requirements.original_text: A declaration of Withdrawal from Tender Participation (Form X, Attachment 4) shall be submitted if tenderer(s) decide not to participate in this tender exercise after the collection of tender document.
requirements.explanation: If a company collects the tender document but decides not to bid, they must submit Form X (Withdrawal).

requirements.source_excerpt: 2.5 Form of Agreement ... a) The successful tenderer shall enter into a service agreement with the Bank.
